People Ops: Quick heads-up — SF hub will be partially closed Wed–Thu (May 14–15) for HVAC upgrades. We still plan to run the engineering onsite that week but a portion of the main floor will be unavailable. Please read below for travel & access guidance.
Darren (Onsite Lead): FYI — main floor desks (1–120) closed; basement + 3rd floor stay open for workspaces and sessions. Sessions in Conf A/B move to 3rd floor.
Emma R: Quick Q — does this impact anyone who reserved a main-floor desk?
People Ops: Yes, anyone with a main-floor reservation will be auto-moved to a hot desk on 3rd floor. If you need a guaranteed seat for the whole week, DM me and we can reserve a desk.
Jin Park: Will there be shuttle service for hotel drop-offs/pickups? I land late Wednesday.
People Ops: We have shuttle runs: Wed arrivals (7:30p) + Thu mornings (7:30am, 8:15am) + Thu evening departures (6:00pm). If you need the Wed late arrival shuttle, add it to the RSVP form: https://forms.redwood.ai/onsite-sf
Facilities Bot: Parking heads-up — garage access limited 8am–6pm Thu for vendor trucks. Alternate parking available at 7th & King lot (validation provided).
Avery: If someone needs to WFH Thu for client meetings, is that OK? I commute from the East Bay.
People Ops: Yes — WFH is OK for client commitments. Please mark "WFH" on the RSVP form so we can account for catering.
Darren (Onsite Lead): Catering update — Thu lunch will be boxed lunches. Please list any dietary restrictions/allergies in the form.
People Ops: Hotel stipend: up to $180/night for up to 2 nights for external attendees. Submit receipts via Expensify with tag `onsite-sf-2025`.
Emma R: Thanks — will update my RSVP. Also, will badge access be different?
People Ops: Good question — badges will work as normal, but main-floor turnstiles may be closed during vendor work. Use the 3rd-floor entrance near the elevators. Security will be on-site to assist.
Facilities Bot: Maintenance contact for the window/HVAC vendor: kaylee@facilities.red (on-site 5/14–5/15, cell +1-415-555-0123).
People Ops: Calendar invites + room map will be posted by Monday. If you have mobility needs or need a nearby hotel for accessibility, DM me and we'll prioritize arrangements. :thumbsup:
Jin Park: Great — thanks everyone.
People Ops: Thanks — we'll post a final logistics summary Monday and update this thread if anything changes.
